messages:
Ada: Quick sync-- chaos run showed a tenant handoff where proxy forwarded writes from EU to US and p95 spiked. Need a short-term safety plan.
Mike: Can you paste the proxy line and any routing headers?
Ada: `2026-05-05T11:10:00Z proxy: tenant=zephyr src=eu-west -> dest=us-east latency=270ms kv_cache=MISS swap=true`
Sara: For EU-residency tenants we should default to deny forwarding unless org admin enables it. Legal wants auditable opt-in, not silent forwarding.
Leo: Two options: (1) Hard-deny non-resident writes (more errors), (2) Allow forwarding with encrypted audit and opt-out guardrails (fewer errors). Middle ground: control-plane tenant flag `allow_forwarding=false` by default; proxies cache it.
Mike: Important: no sync control-plane calls on hot path. Proxy should read cached tenant config with short TTL (10s). On cache miss, return a hint header and route to resident region. Pseudocode: 
```
cfg = tenant_cache.get(id)
if !cfg:
  probe_async(id)
  return 503 + "X-Fallback-Region: <resident>"
if cfg.residency == LOCAL && !cfg.allow_forwarding && !req.header("X-Region-Consent"):
  return 403
if cfg.allow_forwarding || req.header("X-Region-Consent"):
  forward_with_audit()
```
Sara: Audit rules: forwarded payloads must be stored in tenant-scoped EU KMS when origin is EU, and excluded from cross-region analytics. Who can toggle `allow_forwarding`? Product + security + org admin only.
Ada: SDK impact: for streaming/chat, forwarding hurts latency. Add `X-Fallback-Region` support and an SDK `onFallbackRegion` callback so clients can reconnect to resident region.
Mike: Runtime flags proposed: `--tenant-cache-ttl=10s`, `--soft-forward-window=10s`, `--require-heartbeats=2`. Add metrics: `handoff.forward_attempts`, `handoff.forward_denied`, `handoff.audit_bytes`. SLIs: p95 handoff <350ms, error bump <+2%.
RunBot: controlplane: swap_event=1748880025 probes_ok=37 probes_fail=5
Ada: Ops: add operator endpoint to force-refresh tenant cache and a playbook: prewarm cache before planned cutover, mark pending-swap, require N heartbeats, if probes fail set `resident-only`.
Sara: I'll draft compliance bullets and test cases for E2E (simulate forward, verify EU KMS audit, block analytics).
Mike: I'll open an RFC PR with diagram, header proto, pseudocode, ops playbook, metrics. ETA Tue EOD.
Ada: Thanks all, filing infra ticket for metrics and a small SDK change. Closing this thread.
